errorCodes.meaning: The recipient holds no group state for this room. Form one with rooms/owner/group/create, or join by a Welcome.
The KeyPackage did not validate, is for another room's ciphersuite, or its leaf does not identify `member`.
`member` already has a leaf in the group, and the request is not a repeat of the admission that gave it to them (item 8): another KeyPackage, or an admission whose Welcome is no longer kept.
The recipient holds no authority credential conferring `admin` on this room for its caller, so it cannot advance the room's epoch at the host.
The host is at a different epoch than the recipient's group — another admin advanced the room. Catch up (rooms/epoch/commits) and try again. The host's epoch is carried in `details.hostEpoch`.

The named host could not be resolved, advertises no transport this recipient speaks, or did not answer. `details.stage` says which step went unanswered. At `advance` the outcome of an epoch advance is unknown — the host may have accepted it — so the recipient keeps the pending advance and the next request to it settles it (item 6); repeating the identical request is safe, since if the host accepted this admission the repeat is answered with its Welcome (item 8). At `revocation` an earlier removal's revocation list, delivered again to settle that removal (item 6), went unanswered: the earlier removal stays pending, and nothing of this request was done.

An earlier removal from this room was still pending at the recipient, and when it delivered that removal's revocation list to the host again (item 6, by rooms/owner/group/remove 0.3 item 8) the host refused it. The earlier removal did not take effect: `details.member` is still in the group, and is withdrawn at the host only if `details.listKept` is true and the host ever accepted that list. Nothing of this request was done, and the earlier removal is no longer pending, so repeating this request proceeds; remove `details.member` again if that is still wanted. The host's own code is in `details.code`.

The host answered and declined this request's epoch advance. Nothing was changed. The host's own code is in `details.code`, and its reason in `details.reason`. An earlier removal refused while being settled is `earlierRemovalRefused`, never this code.

Response.title: Rooms Owner Group Add — response payload

host.description: The room's host, as a DID: where the room's epoch advances. Named by the caller because the recipient holds key custody, not a hosting register.

keyPackage.description: The newcomer's MLS KeyPackage, base64url without padding, as rooms/keys/key-package returned it.

member.description: The DID being admitted. The KeyPackage's leaf credential MUST identify it; one that names anyone else is refused, so an owner never admits a party other than the one they meant.

reason.description: Why, carried to the host's epoch advance. Untrusted and attributed to its author: it MUST NOT carry personal data or a credential.

roomId.description: The room whose group admits a member. The recipient MUST hold its group.
